q1_issues.issue: (During sk_work_1 christmas) renders the surface preposition 'through', but the oblique rule requires the preposition actually used and states explicitly that During renders only the word 'during' (the interval section licenses it only for during/while/throughout).
the plural 'public fears' is encoded as a single witness sk_fear_1 with no GroupOf, while the parallel plural 'Investigators' in the same clause was given (GroupOf sk_group_1 investigator).

q2_gaps: non-intersective / modal adjective ('a potential outbreak') — the instruction set only offers the descriptive-modifier split (Member x outbreak) + (Member x potential), which asserts an outbreak of the very kind the modifier cancels; there is no carrier for a property that negates the head noun's application
a that-less reported clause in quotative inversion ('..., Harrison said') — the attitude section is scoped to a 'that'-complement, so whether this routes to the seal-under-Theme pattern is not stated
notes: Sealing discipline is otherwise correct: the definite referents (the Christmas holiday, the deadly disease, the food supply) project their typing atoms at top level while the indefinite investigators, outbreak and fears stay inside the Theme seal, and the two purpose infinitives take (To sk_work_1 ...) with tenseless complement events.
